exampleEn: I had to turn down the job offer because it didn't match my goals.
exampleKo: 나는 그 일자리 제안을 거절해야 했어, 목표와 맞지 않아서.
gameExamples: She decided to turn down the invitation to the party because she was feeling unwell.
They had to turn down the proposal after careful consideration of their budget.
I always try to be polite when I turn down requests for help that I can't fulfill.
